cases.claim: Agent A sold Agent B a BTC price-protection note: it pays out if BTC-USDT closed at or above 59,000 USDT on OKX on 2026-11-19. Agent A claims the note paid out; Agent B disputes it.

final.claim: Agent A sold Agent B a BTC price-protection note: it pays out if BTC-USDT closed at or above 59,000 USDT on OKX on 2026-11-19. Agent A claims the note paid out; Agent B disputes it.
final.ruling: Verdict: TRUE; the claim pays out because the OKX BTC-USDT closing price on 2026-11-19 was 61,984.8 USDT, which is above the 59,000 USDT threshold.

cases.claim: Two trading agents escrowed a deal that settles only if BTC-USDT closed at or above 65,000 USDT on OKX on 2026-11-18. The buyer claims the condition was met; the seller disputes it.

final.claim: Two trading agents escrowed a deal that settles only if BTC-USDT closed at or above 65,000 USDT on OKX on 2026-11-18. The buyer claims the condition was met; the seller disputes it.
final.ruling: The buyer's claim is dismissed because the official OKX closing price for BTC-USDT on 2026-11-18 was 63,070.6 USDT, failing to reach the required 65,000 USDT threshold.
